name: semurg-memory
description: Your AI forgets. Semurg gives every AI agent one memory that lasts, shared across your tools and your team, with sources. Connects Claude Code to your Semurg memory over MCP.

node_url.title: Your Semurg address
node_url.description: The MCP address of your Semurg memory. A fresh install serves http://127.0.0.1:4000/v1/mcp

api_token.title: API token
api_token.description: Your Semurg API token (the installer prints it; also in ~/.config/semurg/token)

scope.title: Memory scope
scope.description: Which memory this connection reads and writes. Agents that use the same scope share what is stored
